# Configure-generated files (NOT in upstream openssl/openssl tree).
#
# These files are produced by `./Configure` + `make build_all_generated` against
# upstream OpenSSL with the project's algorithm-disable flag set. They live as
# committed artifacts under Sources/ and MUST be preserved across `vendir sync`
# operations (vendir would otherwise wipe Sources/ paths it doesn't write to).
#
# Regeneration: `scripts/regenerate-configure.sh` (when upstream `.h.in` /
# `.c.in` templates change between bumps).
#
# Captured: 2026-05-01 from openssl-3.6.2 via `subtree extract --clean` survivors
# minus .DS_Store / Placeholder.{h,c}. 100 files.
#
# Format: one path per line, relative to repo root. Lines starting with `#` are
# comments. Blank lines ignored.
